Late-gestation visual sparks, also known as retinal flashes or retinal seizures, are typically associated with early pregnancy and do not occur in late gestation. These flashes are usually brief and may be mistaken for other symptoms of pregnancy such as nausea or fatigue. Therefore, it is generally safe to assume that pregnant individuals should see an eye doctor if they experience these flashes without any other
